testcase.name: Scenario: Apply and restore a body appearance: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-body-properties-source/features/application/body-properties/body-properties.feature:39:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Apply and restore a body appearance ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open in the MCAD Software with its solid body visible ✔ And the body appearance is set to As Part ✔ When the user opens Body Properties for the body from the model browser ✔ And the user selects Black in Body Appearance ✔ And the user chooses OK ✔ Then the dialog closes ✔ And the solid is displayed with the Black appearance ✔ When the user reopens Body Properties for the same body ✔ Then Body Appearance displays Black ✔ When the user selects As Part in Body Appearance ✔ And the user chooses OK ✔ Then the dialog closes ✔ And the solid is displayed with the part appearance
